title: Google Releases Gemini 4 Neon for Coding and Research
summary: Google released Gemini 4 Neon, a model aimed at fast end-to-end work in complex software engineering, knowledge work and research workflows, available to developers, enterprises and Google AI Pro/Ultra subscribers. It is priced at $3 per million input tokens \($0.15 cached\) and $15 per million output tokens, with a 1 million-token context window. Google says Neon ranks first on Artificial Analysis&\#x27;s coding agent index at 58.6, third on its intelligence index at the xhigh setting with 61, scores 65.2% on Terminal-Bench 4.1, and lowers per-task cost by 32% versus Carbon at the default high setting.
